info.title: Enterprise Vision MLOps Control Panel API
info.description: Multi-cycle metadata and guarded mutation contract for the enterprise MLOps Control Panel, including versioned human-authored pipeline profiles, automatic or stepwise lifecycle runs, explicit stage handoffs, evidence-bound model candidate selection, runtime task dispatch, CI evidence, deployment intent state transitions, organizational service scope, drift review, CD/CT gates, and real-test Torch EfficientNet model matrices.

get.summary: Search and list live and historical lifecycle cycles.
Return one lifecycle cycle with lineage, stages, artifacts, serving state, and resource refs.
Return the latest known cycle for dashboard landing state.
List live and historical model candidates with evidence-bound promotion eligibility.

post.summary: Persist an immutable selection for a promotion-eligible model candidate.

409.description: candidate evidence is not promotion eligible

get.summary: Read an immutable model candidate selection audit record.
Return normalized Kubernetes and external worker resource state.
Return orchestrator connection contracts for Airflow, MLflow, and Kubernetes control targets.
